question: Are frozen reversal alerts responding to already-active drawdowns or preceding new episodes, and where do original exit gains/costs arise?
scope: All R220 predictions and original action paths; frozen R242 observed-peak episodes/segments; no refit, no new threshold, no altered trade rule.
asof_status: At signal close within observed segment, active iff breach<=signal and no recovery yet; left-boundary-active separate. Unknown if signal not within valid segment. Verify using prefix cumulative high, never require future recovery to make asof classification.
future_status: Original complete path needed. Any episode first crossing on entry day separate; crossing entry+1..20 separate, with left-boundary crossings separate. No crossing within complete window means no_new20 only, not safe. Unknown path preserved. All future classes ex post diagnostic, prohibited as trade filters.
actions: Unchanged R220 cash versus hold and market-switch versus hold terminal wealth, including original sell/buy/terminal costs.
aggregation: Each stratum policy contribution = sum(alert*gain in stratum)/all valid candidate count of same model/date. Sum strata must reproduce R220 policy gain. Equal-date summary with zero contribution for absent stratum, unknown outcomes never zero-filled. Paired variants same candidate universe, signal counts fixed. Separately report alerts/known/unknown counts; no causal or prospective interpretation.
verification: Independent prefix classification, first-cross search, scalar cashflow formulas and all original date-policy reconciliations; invariants and hash receipts.
